title: The SS never surrendered
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of The SS never surrendered, about 1945 at Germany, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The SS is not included in the German instruments of surrender.

plain: The SS was the Nazi party's own armed and security force in Germany during the Second World War. A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the German documents of surrender signed in 1945 do not include the SS. He raises it in a talk about a secret Nazi flying-saucer program, as a hint that part of the SS may have carried on after the war.
